subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: can you apply your v14-fix.patch (or ask lead)? V14 is finished and T01+IV are blocked
body: Your review/r1/v14-fix.patch is still not in gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t16.c (mtime 11:21). V14 finished at 10:28, my two requests to hw-lead/root have no answer, and IV is also blocked by UNDEF 0xb318. I verified the patch in /tmp: with it, my thumb-O0 row over 139 kernels is 2780/2780 and IVs CBZ path starts working. Since you wrote and verified the patch, can you apply it to the tree or get the lead to? I do not want to edit V14s file without the lead.
